evidence_items.explanation: The researchers describe Bing as a system they could test without access to its internals. They identify GPT-4 as its underlying model and distinguish available high-level descriptions from unavailable implementation details.

The footnote describes Bing's behavior at the time of writing: instructions blocked when entered directly could take effect when encountered indirectly. The preceding methods section explains testing through hidden instructions in pages read by the deployed Edge sidebar.

evidence_items.locator: Introduction; sections How does the new Bing work? and Mitigate
evidence_items.explanation: Microsoft publicly explained Bing's GPT-4 integration, retrieval process, testing, filters, and conversation limits. This qualifies any suggestion of zero disclosure or no safety work, but does not establish public access to model internals or eliminate the demonstrated vulnerability.
